title: Sports and Hobbies
text:
My name is Ali. I like sports very much. On Saturday, I play football with my friends in the park. We play for one hour. After the game, we drink water and talk about the match.

My sister Zeynep likes swimming. She goes to the pool on Monday and Thursday. She swims for thirty minutes. She says swimming makes her happy and strong.

questions.text: What sport does Ali play with his friends?
On which days does Zeynep go to the pool?
How does Ali probably feel after the football game?
What can we guess about Zeynep?
options: She lives far from the pool

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people can relax
a game between two teams or players
a place with water where people swim
having a lot of physical power

paragraph_translations: Benim adım Ali. Sporu çok severim. Cumartesi günü parkta arkadaşlarımla futbol oynarım. Bir saat oynarız. Maçtan sonra su içer ve maç hakkında konuşuruz.
Kız kardeşim Zeynep yüzmeyi sever. Pazartesi ve perşembe günleri havuza gider. Otuz dakika yüzer. Yüzmenin onu mutlu ve güçlü hissettirdiğini söyler.
